expect: organic coating ~3.3 wt% at ~350 °C, carbon black ~4.1 wt% at ~550 °C (p6.L6-7); calcination in air at 600 °C (for 2 h, p3.L21)
question: What two components does the TGA show being burned off the recovered NMC622, how much of each and at what temperature, and what calcination removes both?
rendered:
The TGA-DTG data in Fig. 4a shows that the organic coating layer and CB can be both removed by calcining in air at 600 °C. 

The values from the text are:
- '~3.3 wt%': concentration; of organic coating layer; by TGA-DTG; measures loss
- '~350 °C': temperature; of organic coating layer; by TGA-DTG
- '~4.1 wt%': concentration; of CB; by TGA-DTG; measures loss
- '~550 °C': temperature; of CB; by TGA-DTG

So, the TGA shows that the organic coating layer is burned off at ~350 °C, CB at ~550 °C, and both are 3.3 wt% and 4.1 wt% respectively. Calcination at 600 °C removes both.
